purpose.text: Whiteboard is an open-source desktop app where humans and coding agents architect and review software together on a shared canvas.
purpose.quote: Whiteboard is an open-source desktop app where humans and agents can architect software together in a common workspace.

pain.text: Pure HTML tools made it hard to connect a spec or diagram to the underlying code.
pain.quote: Pure HTML tools didn’t provide easy affordances to connect a spec or diagram to code

pain.text: Raw diff views are noisy, making it hard to see only the relevant code changes.
pain.quote: Raw diff views can be very noisy, so we wrote a semantic, AST-aware diff viewer in Rust

pain.text: It was hard to reason about which decisions agents made autonomously and how they affect a change.
pain.quote: We found it difficult to reason about what set of decisions our agents made autonomously & how that impacts a change.

actors.text: Developers who work with coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex and review the agents' work.
actors.quote: Whiteboard plugs into the tools you already use - e.g. Claude Code, Codex, etc.

actors.text: Coding agents that use the SDK to draw on the canvas and describe their work.
actors.quote: gives your agent an SDK to draw on an in-app canvas to describe its work.

jobs.text: Ask an agent to review the current branch against main and open the result in Whiteboard.
jobs.quote:
Ask your agent to review your current branch against up-to-date main and
   open the result in Whiteboard.

jobs.text: Jump from diagrams or agent trace quotes directly to the underlying code.
jobs.quote: you can jump to the underlying code directly

entry.text: Agent runs this to get Whiteboard's authoring instructions.

non_goals.text: Files cannot currently be edited inside Whiteboard.
non_goals.quote: You cannot currently edit files in Whiteboard.

non_goals.text: Working across multiple repos in a single review isn't well supported.
non_goals.quote: Working and browsing files across multiple repos in a single review isn't well supported.
